task.description: Design test specification and concrete test coverage for OIDC-03 configuration source. Cover provider-type selection, required field validation (provider type, base URL, admin credentials reference, default realm/tenant identifier), and startup-error clarity with field attribution for misconfiguration. Produce/extend tests and spec artifacts required for TEST-RUNNER execution.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/OIDC-03.md exists and maps to OIDC-03 acceptance criteria

result.summary: Designed and extended OIDC-03 test coverage for provider-type selection, required-field validation, timeout-bound misconfiguration matrix, and startup error field attribution with executable unit tests and traceable spec coverage.
